contexts.text: AcmeOps API Limits API Limits The AcmeOps public API uses API keys scoped to one workspace. Starter workspaces can make 120 requests per minute. Growth workspaces can make 600 requests per minute. Enterprise workspaces can negotiate a custom limit. Bulk export jobs are limited to three concurrent jobs per workspace. Export links expire after 48 hours.

contexts.text: # AcmeOps Security Controls AcmeOps supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on on the Enterprise plan. Growth plan customers can add SAML SSO as a paid security add-on. Data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. Data in transit is protected with TLS 1.2 or newer. Audit logs record sign-in events, permission changes, webhook updates, and export jobs. Role-based access control has four default roles: Owner, Admin, Dispatcher, and Viewer. Only Owners can delete a workspace.

rows.question: After a critical AcmeOps incident is closed, do we need to write a postmortem?
rows.answer: Yes, closed SEV-1 incidents require a postmortem within five business days [acme_incident_workflows].
rows.expected_answer: Closed SEV-1 incidents require a postmortem within five business days.

contexts.text: AcmeOps Incident Workflows Incident Workflows AcmeOps can create incidents from email, API calls, manual entry, or alert rules. Each incident receives a severity from SEV-1 to SEV-4. SEV-1 incidents page the on-call owner immediately. SEV-2 incidents notify the dispatcher queue within five minutes. SEV-3 and SEV-4 incidents are grouped into the standard operations inbox. Every incident has an owner, status, due time, customer impact field, and postmortem link. Closed SEV-1 incidents require a postmortem within five business days.

contexts.text: AcmeOps Incident Workflows Incident Workflows AcmeOps can create incidents from email, API calls, manual entry, or alert rules. Each incident receives a severity from SEV-1 to SEV-4. SEV-1 incidents page the on-call owner immediately. SEV-2 incidents notify the dispatcher queue within five minutes. SEV-3 and SEV-4 incidents are grouped into the standard operations inbox. Every incident has an owner, status, due time, customer impact field, and postmortem link. Closed SEV-1 incidents require a postmortem within five business days.

contexts.text: # NimbusDesk AI Policy NimbusDesk response suggestions use the customer's connected knowledge base and recent ticket history. The AI suggestion feature is disabled by default for new workspaces and must be enabled by an Admin. The system does not train vendor foundation models on customer tickets. Customers can opt out of AI logging by contacting support. AI confidence labels are Low, Medium, and High. Agents must review suggestions before sending them to customers.
